source.name: Marketeer: A nova camisola do Casa Pia tem uma novidade e a "culpada" é a bwin
source.quote: A bwin anunciou uma nova parceria com o Casa Pia Atlético Clube para a temporada 2026/2027, passando a integrar os equipamentos oficiais de jogo e treino da equipa profissional do clube lisboeta.
source.note: The club shop's photos of the CAMISOLA PRINCIPAL 26-27 (https://casapiaac.pt/loja/index.php?route=product/product&product_id=363118702; https://casapiaac.pt/loja/image/cache/catalog/26-27/Equipamentos%20oficiais/Equipamento%20Principal%20Abdu-719x900h.png) show bwin across the front of the black home shirt.

source.name: Casa Pia AC, Loja Oficial: CAMISOLA PRINCIPAL 26-27
source.note: The shop's front photos (https://casapiaac.pt/loja/image/cache/catalog/26-27/Equipamentos%20oficiais/Equipamento%20Principal%20Abdu-719x900h.png, https://casapiaac.pt/loja/image/cache/catalog/26-27/Equipamentos%20oficiais/Equipamento%20Principal%20David%20Sousa-719x900h.png) show 'HOSPITAL DA LUZ' on the right chest, beside the adidas logo, above bwin.

source.name: Casa Pia AC, Loja Oficial: CAMISOLA PRINCIPAL 26-27
source.note: The shop's back photo (https://casapiaac.pt/loja/image/cache/catalog/26-27/Equipamentos%20oficiais/Equipamento%20Principal%20Goulart-719x900h.png) shows 'Benecar Cidade do Automóvel' across the upper back, above the player's name.

source.name: Casa Pia AC, Loja Oficial: CAMISOLA PRINCIPAL 26-27
source.note: The shop's back photo (https://casapiaac.pt/loja/image/cache/catalog/26-27/Equipamentos%20oficiais/Equipamento%20Principal%20Goulart-719x900h.png) shows 'SILOGIA' down the sleeve.

source.name: Footy Headlines: Casa Pia 26-27 Home & Away Kits Released
source.quote: The jerseys are made by Adidas, which continues to supply the club's gear following its previous work for the 24-25 and 25-26 seasons.
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention.

summary: bwin on the front from 2026-27 (a new partnership announced in July 2026), with Hospital da Luz on the chest; Benecar on the upper back and Silogia on the sleeve in the club shop's photos of the Camisola Principal 26-27; adidas makes the kit. Not marked complete: the shop's back photo also shows a Meltino Café logo on the lower back and a partly hidden logo below it, which have no record here yet, and no cited source shows the shorts.
